# Skyline Ace

A standalone React Three Fiber rail-shooter vertical slice. It is an original,
asset-free homage to the *Star Fox 64* design vocabulary: fixed-rail movement,
wingmate rescues, barrel rolls, route landmarks, score chasing, and a staged
carrier boss. It intentionally does **not** ship Nintendo names, dialogue,
sounds, models, textures, level geometry, or ripped game data.

## Run

```sh
cd games/skyline-ace
npm install
npm run dev
```

Controls: `WASD`/arrow keys move, `Space` fires, `Shift` boosts, `E` barrels
roll, and `Q` drops a bomb. A/D or Left/Right double-tap also triggers the roll.

## Research notes

The first *Star Fox 64* stage, Corneria, is a forward-scrolling Arwing mission
with a coastal/city assault, three wingmates, rescue encounters, an optional
landmark route, score/medal replay incentives, and the Attack Carrier boss.
Those high-level, mechanically useful facts informed the encounter script.
Exact counts, timings, and route triggers should be verified from a licensed
copy and original footage before building any production-accurate campaign.

Reference reading:

- [StrategyWiki — Star Fox 64 / Corneria](https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Star_Fox_64/Corneria)
- [Star Fox Wiki — Corneria](https://starfox.fandom.com/wiki/Corneria)
- [Star Fox Wiki — Attack Carrier](https://starfox.fandom.com/wiki/Attack_Carrier)
- [Star Fox 64 instruction manual archive](https://www.gamesdatabase.org/Media/SYSTEM/Nintendo_N64/Manual/formated/Star_Fox_64_-_1997_-_Nintendo.pdf)

import { useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { useRef } from 'react'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import type { FlightRuntime } from './types'

const MAX_X = 7.2
const MIN_Y = -2.4
const MAX_Y = 4.7

export function Arwing({ flight }: { flight: FlightRuntime }) {
  const group = useRef<THREE.Group>(null)
  const leftPlume = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null)
  const rightPlume = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null)
  const barrelAngle = useRef(0)

  useFrame(({ clock }, delta) => {
    if (!group.current) return
    const { keys } = flight.input
    let horizontal = 0
    let vertical = 0
    if (keys.has('ArrowLeft') || keys.has('KeyA')) horizontal -= 1
    if (keys.has('ArrowRight') || keys.has('KeyD')) horizontal += 1
    if (keys.has('ArrowUp') || keys.has('KeyW')) vertical += 1
    if (keys.has('ArrowDown') || keys.has('KeyS')) vertical -= 1

    const speed = flight.world.boost ? 18 : 12
    flight.player.target.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(flight.player.target.x + horizontal * speed * delta, -MAX_X, MAX_X)
    flight.player.target.y = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(flight.player.target.y + vertical * speed * delta, MIN_Y, MAX_Y)
    const follow = 1 - Math.exp(-14 * delta)
    group.current.position.lerp(flight.player.target, follow)
    flight.player.position.copy(group.current.position)

    const now = clock.elapsedTime
    const barrel = flight.player.barrel
    if (barrel.active) {
      const progress = THREE.MathUtils.clamp((now - barrel.startedAt) / 0.68, 0, 1)
      barrelAngle.current += barrel.direction * delta * (Math.PI * 2 / 0.68)
      group.current.rotation.z = barrelAngle.current
      if (progress >= 1) {
        barrel.active = false
        barrelAngle.current = 0
      }
    } else {
      const bankTarget = -horizontal * 0.35
      group.current.rotation.z = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(group.current.rotation.z, bankTarget, 1 - Math.exp(-10 * delta))
    }

    const pulse = 0.82 + Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 18) * 0.12 + (flight.world.boost ? 0.32 : 0)
    if (leftPlume.current) leftPlume.current.scale.set(1, pulse, 1)
    if (rightPlume.current) rightPlume.current.scale.set(1, pulse * 0.94, 1)
  })

  return (
    <group ref={group} position={[0, 0, 2.5]}>
      <group scale={0.82}>
        <mesh rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} castShadow>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.62, 2.9, 5]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#b5d9e7" metalness={0.86} roughness={0.24} emissive="#123d5d" emissiveIntensity={0.72} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0, 0.05, 0.6]} rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]}>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.34, 1.15, 5]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#e9fbff" metalness={0.45} roughness={0.2} emissive="#287ca4" emissiveIntensity={0.8} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[-0.95, 0, 0.15]} rotation={[0, 0, -0.12]} castShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[1.85, 0.12, 0.85]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#7eb9d0" metalness={0.8} roughness={0.28} emissive="#0a2c49" emissiveIntensity={0.65} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0.95, 0, 0.15]} rotation={[0, 0, 0.12]} castShadow>
          <boxGeometry args={[1.85, 0.12, 0.85]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#7eb9d0" metalness={0.8} roughness={0.28} emissive="#0a2c49" emissiveIntensity={0.65} flatShading />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[-0.46, -0.15, 0.86]}>
          <boxGeometry args={[0.2, 0.4, 0.55]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#244f73" metalness={0.9} roughness={0.2} emissive="#0a2d52" emissiveIntensity={0.6} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh position={[0.46, -0.15, 0.86]}>
          <boxGeometry args={[0.2, 0.4, 0.55]} />
          <meshStandardMaterial color="#244f73" metalness={0.9} roughness={0.2} emissive="#0a2d52" emissiveIntensity={0.6} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh ref={leftPlume} position={[-0.46, 0, 1.3]} rotation={[Math.PI, 0, 0]}>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.19, 1.05, 8]} />
          <meshBasicMaterial color="#6cf5ff" toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.86} />
        </mesh>
        <mesh ref={rightPlume} position={[0.46, 0, 1.3]} rotation={[Math.PI, 0, 0]}>
          <coneGeometry args={[0.19, 1.05, 8]} />
          <meshBasicMaterial color="#6cf5ff" toneMapped={false} transparent opacity={0.86} />
        </mesh>
        <pointLight position={[-0.46, 0, 1.2]} color="#31eaff" intensity={2.8} distance={7} />
        <pointLight position={[0.46, 0, 1.2]} color="#31eaff" intensity={2.8} distance={7} />
      </group>
    </group>
  )
}

export function CameraRig({ flight }: { flight: FlightRuntime }) {
  const { camera } = useThree()

  useFrame((_, delta) => {
    const follow = 1 - Math.exp(-4.5 * delta)

## Review

- **Blocker — R3F hook outside Canvas:** `src/game/Game.tsx:238-309` calls `useFrame` directly in `Game`, which renders `<Canvas>` as a child. R3F hooks require a Canvas descendant and will throw at runtime.  
  **Fix:** Move the simulation loop into a component rendered inside `<Canvas>`.

- **Blocker — Barrel-roll clock mismatch:** `src/game/Game.tsx:145` stores `performance.now()/1000`, while `src/game/Arwing.tsx:33-40` compares it with `clock.elapsedTime`. The roll progress remains clamped incorrectly and may never finish.  
  **Fix:** Use one time source consistently.

- **Blocker — Laser collision coordinates are local:** `src/game/Laser.tsx:36-37` updates `mesh.position.z` and copies that local position into the collision handle, while the mesh is inside a group positioned at `origin` (`Laser.tsx:46`). Collision X/Y reset to zero and Z omits the origin.  
  **Fix:** Store world coordinates in the handle, e.g. add `origin` to the mesh-local position or use `getWorldPosition`.

- **Blocker — Reset leaves child runtime stale:** `src/game/Game.tsx:138-142` memoizes `flight` forever, but `reset` replaces `input.current`, `world.current`, and `player.current` at lines 312-314. After redeploy, child components continue reading the old runtime objects.  
  **Fix:** Rebuild `flight` when the run changes, or mutate the existing ref contents instead of replacing them.

- **Note — Carrier can expire without ending the stage:** `src/game/Enemy.tsx:46-48` removes enemies after `z > 12`; `Game.tsx:223-231` only marks victory when carrier health reaches zero. An uncleared carrier disappears and the mission remains live indefinitely.  
  **Fix:** Define a carrier-expiry failure/result path.

- **Note — Teammate state is inert:** `src/game/Game.tsx:122` initializes `teammates`, but no code ever changes it. Encounter `target` metadata only affects status text when enemies are removed.  
  **Fix:** Either implement teammate damage/rescue transitions or remove the unused state until supported.

## Review

- **Blocker — R3F hook outside Canvas:** `src/game/Game.tsx:238-309` calls `useFrame` directly in `Game`, which renders `<Canvas>` as a child. R3F hooks require a Canvas descendant and will throw at runtime.  
  **Fix:** Move the simulation loop into a component rendered inside `<Canvas>`.

- **Blocker — Barrel-roll clock mismatch:** `src/game/Game.tsx:145` stores `performance.now()/1000`, while `src/game/Arwing.tsx:33-40` compares it with `clock.elapsedTime`. The roll progress remains clamped incorrectly and may never finish.  
  **Fix:** Use one time source consistently.

- **Blocker — Laser collision coordinates are local:** `src/game/Laser.tsx:36-37` updates `mesh.position.z` and copies that local position into the collision handle, while the mesh is inside a group positioned at `origin` (`Laser.tsx:46`). Collision X/Y reset to zero and Z omits the origin.  
  **Fix:** Store world coordinates in the handle, e.g. add `origin` to the mesh-local position or use `getWorldPosition`.

- **Blocker — Reset leaves child runtime stale:** `src/game/Game.tsx:138-142` memoizes `flight` forever, but `reset` replaces `input.current`, `world.current`, and `player.current` at lines 312-314. After redeploy, child components continue reading the old runtime objects.  
  **Fix:** Rebuild `flight` when the run changes, or mutate the existing ref contents instead of replacing them.

- **Note — Carrier can expire without ending the stage:** `src/game/Enemy.tsx:46-48` removes enemies after `z > 12`; `Game.tsx:223-231` only marks victory when carrier health reaches zero. An uncleared carrier disappears and the mission remains live indefinitely.  
  **Fix:** Define a carrier-expiry failure/result path.

- **Note — Teammate state is inert:** `src/game/Game.tsx:122` initializes `teammates`, but no code ever changes it. Encounter `target` metadata only affects status text when enemies are removed.  
  **Fix:** Either implement teammate damage/rescue transitions or remove the unused state until supported.
